segments.name: Europe/Middle East
segments.description: Distributes a full range of agricultural machinery and precision agriculture technology to customers in the Europe/Middle East region.
segments.evidence: The Company has four operating segments which are also its reportable segments which consist of the Europe/Middle East ("EME"), North America, South America and Asia/Pacific/Africa ("APA") regions.

segments.name: North America
segments.description: Distributes a full range of agricultural machinery and precision agriculture technology to customers in the North America region.
segments.evidence: The Company's reportable segments are geography based and distribute a full range of agricultural machinery and precision agriculture technology.

segments.name: South America
segments.description: Distributes a full range of agricultural machinery and precision agriculture technology to customers in the South America region.
segments.evidence: Net sales decreased in South America in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to sales volume declines, most significantly in tractors and implements.

segments.name: Asia/Pacific/Africa
segments.description: Distributes a full range of agricultural machinery and precision agriculture technology to customers in the Asia/Pacific/Africa region.
segments.evidence: Net sales decreased in APA in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to sales volume declines, most significantly in high-horsepower tractors, hay tools and sprayers.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay AGCO for agricultural machinery, precision agriculture technology and replacement parts sold primarily through independent dealers and distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: We distribute most of our products through approximately 2,800 independent dealers and distributors in approximately 140 countries.

changes.text: In 2024, AGCO divested the majority of its Grain & Protein business, whose results were previously included within the geographic segments and are now shown as "Other".
changes.evidence: "Other" represents the results for the year ended December 31, 2024 for the majority of the Company's G&P business which was divested on November 1, 2024.

changes.text: In 2024, AGCO formed the PTx Trimble joint venture, fundamentally shifting its portfolio.
changes.evidence: In 2024, we fundamentally shifted our portfolio through the PTx Trimble joint venture and the divestiture of the majority of our Grain & Protein ("G&P") business.
